integrity: All mathematical statements concern the one precisely specified two-component model; all proof-critical identities appear in the result text. No independent audit, experimental validation, or historical-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact noise-free two-equal-strength, common-exponent Cole–Cole dielectric-loss model for positive frequencies. Excludes unequal strengths or exponents, instrumental broadening, conductivity backgrounds and finite observation windows. Analytic classification is supported by but does not depend on finite numerical checks. The focal theoretical publication has an explicit 2002-06-28 public publication date; the original 1941 model paper is supporting historical literature with month-only dating in its printed issue.
title: Exact fractional-broadening threshold for two equal Cole–Cole loss peaks
